description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order made under Section 3(3) of the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification that amends an existing order under the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011. It specifies changes to import regulations and HS code classifications for certain materials, which falls under regulatory framework and compliance requirements. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities beyond his title, and the primary focus is on legal/regulatory amendments rather than government personnel or structural changes.
